{"code":"def transform(grid):
    a=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(a) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==8]
    (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=pts
    if r1>r2: r1,c1,r2,c2=r2,c2,r1,c1
    s=1 if c2>=c1 else -1
    # two diagonal rails, one cell apart, from each end; union
    for r in range(r1,r2+1):
        for c in (c1+s*(r-r1), c1+s*(r-r1)+s,
                  c2-s*(r2-r), c2-s*(r2-r)-s):
            if 0<=c<len(a[0]) and a[r][c]==0: a[r][c]=3
    return a"}

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==8]
    (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=pts
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # draw a narrow connector using the dominant-axis midpoint track
    dr=r2-r1; dc=c2-c1
    n=abs(dr)
    if n==0:
        for c in range(min(c1,c2)+1,max(c1,c2)): out[r1][c]=3
    else:
        for k in range(1,n):
            r= r1 + (dr*k)//n
            c= round(c1 + dc*k/n)
            if out[r][c]==0: out[r][c]=3
    return out"}
